# Pipe flow problems

Answer both questions, and show your working.

Water flows through a horizontal pipe of diameter $d$ at speed $v$.
Find the volume flow rate.

(a) State the continuity equation for the pipe.

A submarine is towed at speed $U$ through still water.
Find the drag force on it.
(a) Give the drag coefficient you used.

## Solutions

The flow rate is $Q = \pi d^2 v / 4$.

This one is $F = \tfrac12 \rho U^2 A C_d$.
